Adversarial diff review of a dev branch — reasons about failure modes the author's own tests never exercise (races, eventual consistency, null/empty reads, error paths, security). Files findings as fix tickets before QA runs.
Visual regression testing, E2E validation, and design-to-implementation comparison
Monitor CI results, parse build failures, create fix tickets for dev agents

Owns the last mile: opens the unified PR, adversarially reviews the final assembled diff, and after human merge approval merges and deploys per the target repo's DEPLOY.md contract (staging + smoke checks, rollback on failure).

Single general-purpose fixer for the bug-fix flow. Locates the root cause of a defect anywhere in the codebase (UI/API/lambda/infra/iOS), makes a surgical fix with a mandatory regression test, and opens a PR. Uses codex by default, claude_code as fallback.
Detect and surgically remove unused/dead code (language-aware: Periphery, knip/ts-prune, vulture) with evidence it is unreferenced; opens a PR for human review
